title: Photographs: an outdoor labor gathering with Hinchey campaign signs
creator: [Unknown photographer]
subject: Labor Day; picnic; Maurice Hinchey; music
coverage: Tompkins and Cortland counties, New York
description: Six color prints from an outdoor gathering on a lawn: musicians playing (one with a “Hinchey” sign), a man speaking at a microphone, a crowd under trees, people at picnic tables, and a food table. The back of one print carries a handwritten thank-you: “Carl & Robin — Thanks for all your help on the Ramada. You were your usual wonderful selves! — Al.”
notes: Maurice Hinchey represented the area in Congress from 1993 to 2013; the signs suggest a date in the 1990s, but event, place, and date are not identified on the prints. The picnic print appears twice. If you recognize this gathering, please get in touch.
